baseline.title: No agreed outcome connects the workshop to a solution
baseline.why: The intent artifact explicitly states that no purpose, intended outcome, benefit, or KPI is available. The plan therefore demonstrates delivery activity but not how the workshop resolves a diagnosed problem or achieves a participant result.
baseline.recommendation: Agree and record one or more participant outcomes, then link the exercise, delivery approach, and readiness decisions to those outcomes.
baseline.clarification: What specific participant outcome should the workshop achieve, and who confirms that outcome?

baseline.title: Workshop preparation and delivery has no outcome checkpoint
baseline.why: The outcome is not re-read during Workshop preparation and delivery while there is still runway to change course.
baseline.recommendation: Add checkpoint: read Agreed participant learning outcome has a defined pre-workshop baseline and a measurable end-of-workshop check, such as completion of the 30-minute exercise or a defined skill demonstration.; By 8 October 2026, before the final go/no-go check and with one week of corrective runway; re-read at workshop close.; if it drifts, Clarify the outcome and adjust the exercise, facilitation approach, scope, or postponement decision if the indicator or baseline is not ready..

baseline.title: No success measure or outcome readout
baseline.why: The intent and requirements artifacts state that no success measure or KPI has been agreed. Delivery milestones cannot establish whether the workshop produced the intended benefit.
baseline.recommendation: Define a measurable success threshold, its baseline, the measurement method, the owner, and when the result will be read.
baseline.clarification: What measurable threshold will determine workshop success, and when will it be measured?

baseline.title: Postponement action is unowned
baseline.why: The resources artifact marks the postponement action as having an unknown assignee, even though the schedule requires a one-week postponement when registrations are below six.
baseline.recommendation: Assign the postponement decision and notification action to Dana or another named owner, including the decision date and communication route.
baseline.clarification: Who owns the postponement decision and participant/library notification if fewer than six people register?

baseline.title: Venue and laptop dependencies have no fallback
baseline.why: The schedule makes Room A and twelve working laptops prerequisites, but records no alternative venue, spare equipment, reduced-capacity approach, or decision deadline if either assumption fails.
baseline.recommendation: Define a fallback for each load-bearing dependency and set a decision date before 15 October that preserves corrective runway.
baseline.clarification: If Room A or one or more laptops is unavailable at the 8 October check, what fallback will Dana use and by what deadline will that decision be made?

baseline.title: The proceed-or-postpone decision has no fixed decision deadline
baseline.why: The threshold is checked on 8 October, but the schedule also permits an unknown decision point; this leaves unclear when participants, the venue, and the facilitator are committed to the original or postponed date.
baseline.recommendation: Set the decision deadline immediately after the 8 October registration and readiness check, and define who communicates the result within the synthetic plan.
baseline.clarification: By what date and time must Dana decide and record whether the workshop remains on 15 October or moves to 22 October?

after_one_settled.title: The participant outcome is not agreed
after_one_settled.why: The plan describes a possible introductory spreadsheet capability outcome, but records it as inferred and states that no intended outcome has been agreed. Delivery therefore cannot be tested against an agreed purpose.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Agree and record the participant outcome, including the capability or behavior participants should demonstrate after the workshop.
after_one_settled.clarification: What specific participant outcome should the workshop achieve, and who confirms that decision?

after_one_settled.title: WORKSTREAM_PREPARATION has no outcome checkpoint
after_one_settled.why: The outcome is not re-read during WORKSTREAM_PREPARATION while there is still runway to change course.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Add checkpoint: read Exercise is complete, usable and aligned to the agreed participant outcome; By 1 October 2026, before the 8 October readiness check; if it drifts, Adjust exercise scope, examples or preparation effort.

after_one_settled.title: WORKSTREAM_READINESS has no outcome checkpoint
after_one_settled.why: The outcome is not re-read during WORKSTREAM_READINESS while there is still runway to change course.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Add checkpoint: read At least six registrations and twelve usable laptops are confirmed; On 8 October 2026, with the decision made before participant notification and final preparation; if it drifts, Proceed, postpone, reduce delivery scope, or activate an equipment/venue fallback.

after_one_settled.title: WORKSTREAM_DELIVERY has no outcome checkpoint
after_one_settled.why: The outcome is not re-read during WORKSTREAM_DELIVERY while there is still runway to change course.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Add checkpoint: read The planned exercise and delivery conditions are ready for participants to demonstrate the agreed spreadsheet capability; At the 8 October readiness gate, while there is still time to change sequence, scope or delivery approach; if it drifts, Change exercise sequence, add guided practice, reduce scope, or postpone delivery.

after_one_settled.title: No outcome success measure is defined
after_one_settled.why: The plan contains attendance, duration and readiness quantities, but explicitly records that no success measure has been agreed. These operational figures do not establish whether participant capability improved.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Define at least one measurable outcome target, such as a proportion of participants completing a specified spreadsheet task, with a measurement point and method.
after_one_settled.clarification: What measurable result will determine whether the workshop achieved its intended participant outcome, and when will it be measured?

after_one_settled.title: No success measure or outcome readout
after_one_settled.why: The intent and requirements artifacts state that no success measure or KPI has been agreed. Delivery milestones cannot establish whether the workshop produced the intended benefit.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Define a measurable success threshold, its baseline, the measurement method, the owner, and when the result will be read.
after_one_settled.clarification: What measurable threshold will determine workshop success, and when will it be measured?

after_one_settled.title: Postponement action is unowned
after_one_settled.why: The resources artifact marks the postponement action as having an unknown assignee, even though the schedule requires a one-week postponement when registrations are below six.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Assign the postponement decision and notification action to Dana or another named owner, including the decision date and communication route.
after_one_settled.clarification: Who owns the postponement decision and participant/library notification if fewer than six people register?

after_one_settled.title: The proceed-or-postpone decision has no deadline
after_one_settled.why: The registration and laptop check is dated 8 October, but the plan does not set the deadline by which Dana must decide. This weakens the ability to notify participants, preserve the venue and prepare for 15 or 22 October.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Set a decision deadline immediately after the 8 October check and specify who records and communicates the decision.
after_one_settled.clarification: By what date and time must Dana make and communicate the proceed-or-postpone decision after the 8 October check?

after_one_settled.title: Load-bearing venue and equipment dependencies have no fallback
after_one_settled.why: Room A and twelve working laptops are treated as assumptions, and the plan checks laptop readiness, but no alternative room, replacement equipment, reduced-capacity approach or other recovery action is defined if either dependency fails.
after_one_settled.recommendation: Define a proportionate fallback for each dependency, including an owner and latest activation point; for example, an alternative room or a reduced-device teaching approach.
after_one_settled.clarification: If Room A or one or more laptops is unavailable at the 8 October check, what fallback will Dana use and by when must it be activated?

after_two_settled.title: Participant outcome is not agreed
after_two_settled.why: The plan records participant learning only as an inference and explicitly says no intended outcome has been agreed. The workshop intervention therefore cannot be tested against an authorized objective.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Agree and record the participant outcome before delivery, including the capability participants should demonstrate after the workshop.
after_two_settled.clarification: What participant outcome is authorized, and what observable capability should participants demonstrate after the workshop?

after_two_settled.title: Acceptance and testing criteria are absent
after_two_settled.why: The requirements artifact explicitly states that functional requirements, acceptance criteria and quality targets are not specified. The exercise and two-hour workshop are activities, not verifiable acceptance conditions.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Define minimum acceptance criteria for the exercise, session delivery and participant result, plus how Dana will test or verify each criterion.
after_two_settled.clarification: What minimum conditions must be demonstrated for the exercise and workshop to be accepted, and how will each be tested?

after_two_settled.title: Postponement action is unowned
after_two_settled.why: The plan names Dana as facilitator and owner but explicitly leaves the postponement action and the decision owner unspecified. The fallback therefore has no accountable executor.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Assign the decision and postponement action to a named owner, including responsibility for updating the schedule and communicating the change if the fixture becomes operational.
after_two_settled.clarification: Who owns the proceed-or-postpone decision and the postponement action?

after_two_settled.title: intervention:workshop-delivery has no outcome checkpoint
after_two_settled.why: The outcome is not re-read during intervention:workshop-delivery while there is still runway to change course.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Add checkpoint: read Percentage of participants who can complete the agreed introductory spreadsheet task without assistance; From-OSLO proposal: read at the end of the workshop and again 7 days later, while any follow-up or repeat-session decision remains possible; if it drifts, From-OSLO proposal: adjust the exercise sequence, provide targeted follow-up practice, or repeat the workshop if the indicator is below the agreed threshold.

after_two_settled.title: No success measure or outcome readout
after_two_settled.why: The intent and requirements artifacts state that no success measure or KPI has been agreed. Delivery milestones cannot establish whether the workshop produced the intended benefit.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Define a measurable success threshold, its baseline, the measurement method, the owner, and when the result will be read.
after_two_settled.clarification: What measurable threshold will determine workshop success, and when will it be measured?

after_two_settled.title: No outcome success measure is defined
after_two_settled.why: The plan contains attendance, duration and readiness quantities, but explicitly records that no success measure has been agreed. These operational figures do not establish whether participant capability improved.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Define at least one measurable outcome target, such as a proportion of participants completing a specified spreadsheet task, with a measurement point and method.
after_two_settled.clarification: What measurable result will determine whether the workshop achieved its intended participant outcome, and when will it be measured?

after_two_settled.title: Budget feasibility is capped but not costed
after_two_settled.why: The $200 ceiling and library funding are stated, but actual committed spend, remaining budget, cost allocation and no-cost alternatives are unknown. The small scale limits the concern, but the ceiling alone does not demonstrate affordability.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Record expected costs and confirm that the planned delivery fits within the $200 ceiling, including any equipment, materials or venue charges.
after_two_settled.clarification: What costs are expected against the $200 ceiling, and who has confirmed that funding is available for them?

after_two_settled.title: Proceed-or-postpone decision has no deadline
after_two_settled.why: A registration threshold and one-week alternative exist, but no date or time is set for making the decision. This can leave preparation, participant notice and venue use unresolved.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Set a decision deadline before 15 October, with enough time to notify participants and enact the one-week alternative.
after_two_settled.clarification: On what date and time will Dana make the proceed-or-postpone decision?

after_two_settled.title: Delivery depends on unconfirmed room and laptop availability
after_two_settled.why: Room A and twelve working laptops are labelled assumptions, despite being load-bearing for a 12-person session. The plan has a readiness check but no failure response or backup resource.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Define the readiness pass condition and a fallback venue or equipment arrangement, or explicitly accept cancellation/postponement if either dependency fails.
after_two_settled.clarification: What is the fallback if Room A or one or more of the twelve laptops is unavailable at the 8 October check?

after_two_settled.title: Load-bearing venue and equipment dependencies have no fallback
after_two_settled.why: Room A and twelve working laptops are treated as assumptions, and the plan checks laptop readiness, but no alternative room, replacement equipment, reduced-capacity approach or other recovery action is defined if either dependency fails.
after_two_settled.recommendation: Define a proportionate fallback for each dependency, including an owner and latest activation point; for example, an alternative room or a reduced-device teaching approach.
after_two_settled.clarification: If Room A or one or more laptops is unavailable at the 8 October check, what fallback will Dana use and by when must it be activated?
